description: This file is a PHP source file defining the ReturnAction controller class within the OpenCart admin system. It manages CRUD operations for return actions, including listing, form display, save, and delete functionalities, and integrates with other parts of the framework such as models, views, language files, and URL routing.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Controller class for managing return actions within the OpenCart admin interface, providing CRUD operations and integrating with models, views, and language files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the return action listing page with header, footer, breadcrumbs, and list data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct calls to output the return actions list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of return actions, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return action.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for creating or updating a return action, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions after permission and dependency checks.
